svg.title: DEXPI example PID - Utilities - standby pump P-4712B added (rev. R2.3)
svg.desc: Redrawn from reference.xml (DEXPI P&ID, sheet 2a, Utilities). Coordinates are the file's millimetre coordinates with the Y axis flipped for SVG. Added in this revision: P-4712B, V-4712B-S, CV-4712B-D, V-4712B-D, PipeTee-6, PipeTee-7, XSA4712.03, XY4712.04. Added tags are drawn in red.

g.text: REV. R2.3 - STANDBY PUMP P-4712B ADDED (P-4712 HAD NO SPARE)
1 P-4712B is the standby for P-4712 and runs in parallel with it: suction from T-4750, discharge into header 47126.
2 Suction: tee on line 47124 downstream of ButterflyValve-1 (upstream of SwingCheckValve-1), then own isolating valve V-4712B-S.
3 Discharge: own check valve CV-4712B-D, then own isolating valve V-4712B-D, into header 47126 at PipeTee-7 (between PipeTee-1 and PipeTee-3).
4 V-4712B-S and V-4712B-D are normally open so that P-4712B stays lined up and can start at once; CV-4712B-D stops back-flow through the idle pump.
5 P-4712 trips: XSA4712.03 detects the trip and raises the alarm, XY4712.04 starts P-4712B automatically (signals shown dashed blue).
6 Product keeps leaving the sheet: the 47126 outlet to the next sheet stays supplied by P-4712B. The green band is the flow route with P-4712 tripped.
7 Red tags are new in this revision. P-4712 and T-4750 are shown with the tags given for this revision (the source file carries them as P4712 and T4750).
